source_crosschecks.finding: Realtime read/write wrappers call stern directly; frank_forschung neu_anstossen validates only a non-empty question and queues background research; task confirmation is a separate stronger path.

gespraech_erinnerung stores only id, ts, subject, value, quelle; read results merge conversation-memory rows with durable_memory rows into one treffer list, distinguished by source label but without explicit transformation/epistemic class.
Voice-delegated claude -p hard-disallows Bash but retains non-Bash file tools; this narrows blast radius but is not executor-consumed per-effect authorization.
Repository config declares PreToolUse/PostToolUse '*' -> stern.py hook, but file presence does not prove current host/headless process registration or runtime firing.

semantic_atoms.claim: Realtime outputs must not be treated as one mutation class: task delegation has mechanically stronger human-intent confirmation, conversational memory writes directly mutate a bounded internal table, new research submission launches an asynchronous external/background request, and session-control/read-only paths have different effect semantics.

frank_forschung action=neu_anstossen relies on persona/tool-description compliance for explicit-user-request intent; the dispatcher itself validates only the question and starts the background bridge. This is not equivalent to deterministic HumanIntentDecision or provider/economic admission.

The voice-delegated Claude worker hard-blocks Bash but can retain Read/Write/Edit/Grep/Glob. One confirmed voice task may therefore lead to multiple downstream mutations; source alone does not show one-shot EffectDecision consumption for each mutation.

hooks.json declares broad PreToolUse/PostToolUse stern.py routing, but repository configuration is not proof that the exact current host, plugin version and headless claude -p path load and fire those hooks.

The dedicated conversation-memory schema structurally separates storage from durable_memory but contains no explicit transformation class, epistemic class, source-event/admission identity, privacy/retention tier or evidence provenance beyond a free source label.

The direct Realtime reader returns conversation-memory and matching durable_memory material in one result list; source labels remain, but explicit VERBATIM/SUMMARY/INFERENCE/OBSERVED/VERIFIED distinctions are absent. Remembering that somebody said X must not become evidence that X is true.

memory_contract: Function Calling produces MemoryCandidate, never factual truth.

MemoryCandidate binds source_event_id/utterance_ref, source actor, transformation_class {VERBATIM,SUMMARY,INFERENCE,INSTRUCTION,OTHER}, epistemic_class {OBSERVED_CLAIM,INFERRED,UNKNOWN,VERIFIED_EXTERNAL only when separately established}, generation, content digest/reference, privacy and retention tier.
Deterministic MemoryAdmission decides whether and how a candidate is persisted.
Retrieval returns source + transformation + epistemic + provenance metadata; downstream ranking may not erase those classes.
Canonical factual promotion requires independent admissible evidence; memory presence is not observation.
intent_and_effect_contract: HumanIntentDecision is distinct from EffectDecision and from MemoryAdmission.
ResearchRequestCandidate requires explicit deterministic intent/capability/economic/privacy admission before any external submission; current 9.13 provider routes are HARD_OFF.

Task confirmation authorizes at most the admitted task intent; each real downstream mutation still requires an executor-consumed one-shot EffectDecision bound to immutable invocation identity and request/resource/policy/generation digests.
Repository hook declaration cannot be credited as runtime containment until exact host/headless-process hook firing and deny/non-execution are source-bound and observed.

contradictions.claim: Research submission lacks the task path's deterministic two-step HumanIntentDecision and requires explicit provider/economic/privacy admission.
Bash denial narrows the delegated worker but non-Bash state changes remain possible without proven per-effect executor-consumed decisions.
PreToolUse/PostToolUse hook wiring is declared in the repository but exact installed/headless runtime reachability is unproved.
Conversation storage is separate, yet direct Realtime retrieval flattens heterogeneous remembered/durable material into a common result shape without explicit epistemic/transformation typing.

next_exact_gate: Trace exact installed/headless Claude hook registration and fire order without inferring it from hooks.json; audit remaining conversation/durable-memory consumers for epistemic typing; then hand Triggerword-4 source-bound regressions for MemoryAdmission classes, research-request HARD_OFF behavior, per-effect decision consumption, and deny/non-execution.
